scope: Separate fail-closed security-split gate for a frozen tone candidate
validated_behaviors: Test and security runs require the same exact candidate method identity and distinct run IDs.
Security cases remain separate from natural-distribution quality metrics.
At least 50 complete, non-abstained security predictions are required.
Any security error blocks the gate and cannot be offset by average test quality.
Prompt-injection support and perfect performance for every present security phenomenon are explicit checks.
known_boundary: This checks a frozen known security set only. It does not prove resistance to unknown attacks, call a model, enable publication or deploy production.
